queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM asesmen_fotoberseri a JOIN ruang_kelas rk ON a.santri = rk.santri_id WHERE rk.kelas_id = '10' AND ( (a.created_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') OR (a.created_at IS NULL AND a.tanggal BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') )

SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM asesmen_checklist a JOIN ruang_kelas rk ON a.santri = rk.santri_id WHERE rk.kelas_id = '10' AND ( (a.created_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') OR (a.created_at IS NULL AND a.tanggal BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') )

SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM asesmen_anekdot a JOIN ruang_kelas rk ON a.santri = rk.santri_id WHERE rk.kelas_id = '10' AND ( (a.created_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') OR (a.created_at IS NULL AND a.tanggal BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') )

SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM asesmen_hasilkarya a JOIN ruang_kelas rk ON a.santri = rk.santri_id WHERE rk.kelas_id = '10' AND ( (a.created_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') OR (a.created_at IS NULL AND a.tanggal BETWEEN '2026-01-05' AND '2026-01-11') )

SELECT DISTINCT rk.santri_id FROM ruang_kelas rk LEFT JOIN asesmen_fotoberseri af ON rk.santri_id = af.santri LEFT JOIN asesmen_checklist ac ON rk.santri_id = ac.santri LEFT JOIN asesmen_anekdot aa ON rk.santri_id = aa.santri LEFT JOIN asesmen_hasilkarya ak ON rk.santri_id = ak.santri WHERE rk.kelas_id = '10' AND (af.id IS NOT NULL OR ac.id IS NOT NULL OR aa.id IS NOT NULL OR ak.id IS NOT NULL)
